name: Vale LS
description: Configurable prose style linting with Vale, exposed as a language server.
notes: Vale LS exposes Vale's configurable prose linting through LSP. It is designed for editorial style enforcement rather than general-purpose grammar, and works with Vale configuration files and style packages. Vale requires a .vale.ini, a StylesPath, and a document to lint, so the Docker image ships a default config at /workspace/.vale.ini with the proselint and write-good packages synced at build time; without a config no diagnostics are produced for any file type. System mode builds the pinned Vale LS Git tag with Cargo and expects a config on the host. Docker mode builds Vale LS and lsp-ws-proxy in separate stages and includes the external processors used by reStructuredText, AsciiDoc, and MDX. Vale has no LaTeX parser: .tex is mapped to Markdown through a format association, which is an extension-level substitution only, so LaTeX markup is linted as prose.
author: TeXlyre
